name: Unit
comment: Types of Units that can be found in the game - e.g. APC, Light Tank etc.

properties.name: IsCrateGoodie
properties.comment: If this unit can appear out of a crate, then this flag will be true.

properties.name: IsPieceOfEight
properties.comment: Does this unit have only 8 facings? Special test units have limited facings.

properties.name: IsCrusher
properties.comment: Can this unit squash infantry? If it can then if the player selects an (enemy) infantry unit as the movement target, it will ride over and squish the infantry unit.

properties.name: IsToHarvest
properties.comment: Does this unit go into harvesting mode when it stops on a tiberium field? Typically, only one unit does this and that is the harvester.

properties.name: IsChunkyShape
properties.comment: Does this unit's shape data consist of "chunky" facings? This kind of unit art has the unit in only 4 facings (N, W, S, and E) and in each of those directions, the unit's turrets rotates 32 facings (counter clockwise from north). This will result in 32 x 4 = 128 unit shapes in the shape data file.

properties.name: IsRadarEquipped
properties.comment: Some units are equipped with a rotating radar dish. These units have special animation processing. The rotating radar dish is similar to a turret, but always rotates and does not affect combat.

properties.name: IsFireAnim
properties.comment: If this unit has a firing animation, this flag is true. Infantry and some special vehicles are the ones with firing animations.

properties.name: IsLockTurret
properties.comment: Many vehicles have a turret with restricted motion. These vehicles must move the turret into a locked down position while travelling. Rocket launchers and artillery are good examples of this kind of unit.

properties.name: IsTracked
properties.comment: Does this unit lay tracks when it travels? Most tracked vehicles and some wheeled vehicles have this ability.

properties.name: IsGigundo
properties.comment: Is this unit of the humongous size? Harvesters and mobile construction vehicles are of this size. If the vehicle is greater than 24 x 24 but less than 48 x 48, it is considered "Gigundo".

properties.name: IsCloakable
properties.comment: Is the unit capable of cloaking? Only Stealth Tank can do so now.

properties.name: IsAnimating
properties.comment: Does this unit have a constant animation (like Visceroid?)

properties.name: Type
properties.valid_values: NONE, HTANK, MTANK, LTANK, STANK, FTANK, VICE, APC, MLRS, JEEP, BUGGY, HARVESTER, ARTY, MSAM, HOVER, MHQ, GUNBOAT, MCV, BIKE, TRIC, TREX, RAPT, STEG
properties.comment: This value represents the unit class. It can serve as a unique identification number for this unit class.

properties.name: Speed
properties.valid_values: NONE, FOOT, TRACK, HARVESTER, WHEEL, WINGED, HOVER, FLOAT
properties.comment: This indicates the speed (locomotion) type for this unit. Through this value the movement capabilities are deduced.

properties.name: ROT
properties.comment: This is the rotational speed of the unit. This value represents the turret rotation speed.

properties.name: TurretOffset
properties.comment: This is the distance along the centerline heading in the direction the body is facing used to reach the center point of the turret. This distance is in leptons.

properties.name: Mission
properties.valid_values: NONE, SLEEP, ATTACK, MOVE, RETREAT, GUARD, STICKY, ENTER, CAPTURE, HARVEST, GUARD_AREA, RETURN, STOP, AMBUSH, HUNT, TIMED_HUNT, UNLOAD, SABOTAGE, CONSTRUCTION, DECONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, RESCUE, MISSILE
properties.comment: This value is used to provide the unit with a default mission order when first created. Usually, this is a resting or idle type of order.

properties.name: Explosion
properties.valid_values: NONE, FBALL1, GRENADE, FRAG1, FRAG2, VEH_HIT1, VEH_HIT2, VEH_HIT3, ART_EXP1, NAPALM1, NAPALM2, NAPALM3, SMOKE_PUFF, PIFF, PIFFPIFF, FLAME_N, FLAME_NE, FLAME_E, FLAME_SE, FLAME_S, FLAME_SW, FLAME_W, FLAME_NW, CHEM_N, CHEM_NE, CHEM_E, CHEM_SE, CHEM_S, CHEM_SW, CHEM_W, CHEM_NW, FIRE_SMALL, FIRE_MED, FIRE_MED2, FIRE_TINY, MUZZLE_FLASH, SMOKE_M, BURN_SMALL, BURN_MED, BURN_BIG, ON_FIRE_SMALL, ON_FIRE_MED, ON_FIRE_BIG, SAM_N, SAM_NE, SAM_E, SAM_SE, SAM_S, SAM_SW, SAM_W, SAM_NW, GUN_N, GUN_NE, GUN_E, GUN_SE, GUN_S, GUN_SW, GUN_W, GUN_NW, LZ_SMOKE, ION_CANNON, ATOM_BLAST, CRATE_DEVIATOR, CRATE_DOLLAR, CRATE_EARTH, CRATE_EMPULSE, CRATE_INVUN, CRATE_MINE, CRATE_RAPID, CRATE_STEALTH, CRATE_MISSILE, ATOM_DOOR, MOVE_FLASH, OILFIELD_BURN, TRIC_DIE, TREX_DIE, STEG_DIE, RAPT_DIE, CHEM_BALL, FLAG, BEACON, FIRE_SMALL_VIRTUAL, FIRE_MED_VIRTUAL, FIRE_MED2_VIRTUAL, FIRE_TINY_VIRTUAL, BEACON_VIRTUAL
properties.comment: This is the default explosion to use when this vehicle is destroyed.
